intro: CAVA Garlic Dressing is a rich, aromatic dressing that brings bold garlic flavor to any bowl or pita. Made with roasted garlic, oil, and vinegar, this emulsified dressing delivers restaurant-quality taste with every drizzle. Available at no extra charge with your meal from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings), it transforms simple ingredients into a memorable Mediterranean dining experience.
priceCalories: CAVA Garlic Dressing is included free with your order (up to 2 dressings) and contains 180 calories per serving. With 20g of fat and 0g each of protein and carbs, this dressing adds substantial flavor and richness without carbohydrates. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how it fits into your custom bowl or pita creation.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Garlic Dressing apart is its slow-roasted garlic base that mellows the sharpness while intensifying the savory depth. The emulsified blend of quality oils and vinegar creates a creamy, pourable consistency that coats every ingredient evenly. Unlike raw garlic dressings, the roasting process brings out sweet, caramelized notes that complement Mediterranean flavors perfectly throughout the [full CAVA menu](/menu).
nutritionFacts: Each serving of CAVA Garlic Dressing delivers 180 calories with 20g of fat as its primary macronutrient. The dressing contains 0g of protein and 0g of carbohydrates, making it a pure fat source ideal for keto and low-carb diets. The calorie density comes from quality oils used in the emulsification process, providing satisfying richness and flavor concentration.
whatsInside: CAVA Garlic Dressing features three simple ingredients: roasted garlic, oil, and vinegar blended into a smooth emulsified dressing. The roasted garlic provides the signature flavor foundation, while quality oils create richness and mouthfeel. Vinegar adds brightness and acidity to balance the garlic intensity, creating a well-rounded dressing that enhances vegetables, grains, and proteins from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases).
tasteLike: CAVA Garlic Dressing tastes like rich, roasted garlic with a creamy, tangy finish. The initial flavor is bold and savory with sweet caramelized garlic notes, followed by a subtle vinegar brightness that cuts through the richness. The texture is smooth and velvety, coating your palate with lingering garlic essence that enhances rather than overwhelms other ingredients.
customize: Customize your CAVA experience by pairing Garlic Dressing with complementary options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). Add it to grain bowls with roasted vegetables for maximum flavor impact, or use it alongside a lighter second dressing for dimension. Drizzle over protein-focused bowls or request it on the side for controlled portions that let you adjust intensity.
pairsWell: CAVA Garlic Dressing pairs exceptionally well with roasted vegetables, grilled chicken, and hearty grains like brown rice or black lentils. It complements the brightness of Greek Vinaigrette (130 cal) and balances the heat of Hot Harissa Vinaigrette (70 cal). The bold garlic flavor enhances mild proteins and adds depth to fresh greens throughout [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) options.
healthyChoice: While CAVA Garlic Dressing contains 180 calories from 20g of fat, it offers benefits for specific dietary approaches. The zero-carb profile makes it excellent for keto and low-carb diets. The fat content provides satiety and helps absorb fat-soluble vitamins from vegetables. For calorie-conscious diners, consider using half portions or pairing with lighter dressings from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings).
howToOrder: Order CAVA Garlic Dressing by building your custom bowl or pita and selecting it from the dressings section. You can choose up to 2 dressings at no additional charge. Request it on the side for portion control, ask for a light drizzle, or have it mixed throughout your bowl. Available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations), it works with any base, protein, and topping combination.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Greek Vinaigrette at 130 calories, Garlic Dressing offers richer, more intense flavor with 50 additional calories. Lemon Herb Tahini (70 cal) and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette (70 cal) provide less than half the calories but different flavor profiles. Skhug (80 cal) brings herbal heat versus the savory garlic depth. Garlic Dressing delivers maximum richness and bold taste for those prioritizing flavor intensity.
whoShouldTry: CAVA Garlic Dressing is perfect for garlic lovers who want bold, savory flavor in their Mediterranean bowls. Keto and low-carb dieters appreciate the zero-carb, high-fat profile. Those who enjoy rich, restaurant-style dressings over lighter vinaigrettes will find this especially satisfying. If you prefer milder flavors, explore options on the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) instead.
worthTrying: CAVA Garlic Dressing is absolutely worth trying if you appreciate bold, roasted garlic flavor that transforms ordinary ingredients into extraordinary meals. Being included free with your order makes it risk-free to sample. The quality roasted garlic base and smooth emulsification rival premium bottled dressings. For garlic enthusiasts seeking restaurant-quality taste, this dressing delivers exceptional value and flavor that enhances any bowl.
